cover.text: Q polls, real-time events for QIE, turn on chain activity into alerts, payments and proof.

problem.text: A customer pays, a wallet moves funds, a contract emits an event. Without an event layer, teams keep polling, shops refresh, explorers, and useful signals get missed.

solution.text: Qpos reads QIE blocks through one shared indexer. Matches the events you care about and delivers them to your chat or application.

signin.text: Open Q-Pose and sign in with your QIE wallet, approve the sign in message. This is a signature with no transaction and no gas fee.

template.text: Choose the shop payment template. Enter orchard.qie. QPulse resolves the name on chain. Select the assets you want to watch, such as QIE and QUSDC.

telegram.text: Connect a telegram chat, then send the one-time code to the queue postbot. Once the chat is linked, select it as the destination and create your hook.

alert.text: A customer pays the shop, the telegram hook sends a payment alert, a separate webhook hook delivers the event to your server with a signature your application can verify.

paylink.text: For a specific order, create a payment link for 35QUSDC, share the checkout, the customer pays, and the page updates to paid after confirmation funds go straight to the recipient.

traction.text: Project teams can publish traction pages with real wallet and transaction counts. Daily commitments are anchored on QIE. Anyone can use verify in your browser to check the numbers against the Explorer and on-chain proof.

communities.text: Community managers can choose the QUSDC whale moves template, set a minimum transfer size and send large move alerts into their connected chat.

traders.text: Traders can watch new QIE text pairs, set price thresholds, or configure the rogue pool radar to flag liquidity drops. These are signals to investigate rather than trading guarantees.

holders.text: holders and treasury teams can watch wallet activity, token approvals and safe events. Address poisoning and look alike token warnings help them inspect suspicious transfers before acting.

sellers.text: Sellers can create reusable product links and QR checkout, share the link or display the code. Then use a payment event to trigger order fulfillment in their own application.

developers.text: Developers create an API key, connect sign webhooks, or use q-pose web socket RPC for new head and log subscriptions. Their apps can react without maintaining a separate upstream polling loop.

agents.text: AI agents connect through the MCP server with an account API key that can create payment links with for payment and query chain data as part of a larger workflow.

close.text: Start free with Q-Poles. Connect your wallet, choose the template, and turn the next on-chain event into something useful. Watch a lot, proof.
